title: site-diff — one command that shows what changed on the site since the last landing (Sonnet)

set.request: site-diff: one command that shows what changed on the site since the last landing — baseline + compare over 40 representative pages, masking the framework live clock, exit non-zero on new errors/sideways scroll
set.now: reopened - coordinator found a real navigation race in compare (two urls on one Page object) plus errored shots silently counted as unchanged; fixing both
steps: write site-diff.mjs: arg parsing, browser pool, masks
pixel diff via a canvas lab page + report.json + exit code
set.outcome:
**Fix landed** — the coordinator's real `compare` run hit `page.goto: Navigation to X is interrupted by another navigation to Y` on several `styles/layouts/*` shots at 3440. Root cause: NOT a shared-Page bug (the pool already gave every url its own Page for its whole goto→settle→shoot lifecycle, and the new per-page ownership assertion never fired) — it's Chromium/Playwright itself cross-wiring two DIFFERENT Page objects when their `.goto()` calls start at nearly the same instant. Fix: `serialGoto()` wraps only the `.goto()` call in a tiny async lock, browser-wide — waiting for fonts, masking and screenshotting still run concurrently across the 4-page pool.

Verified: 2 fresh baseline+compare pairs after the fix, 160 total shots, 0 errored, 0 missing files (vs 24-of-40 erroring before the fix, reproduced once for confirmation). Also fixed: an errored/missing shot now reports `changed: "unknown"`, sorts to the top of the table, adds a `(N unknown — shot errored)` clause to the summary line, and fails the exit code — all verified live in the pre-fix run (24 unknown, exit 1).

One compare run afterward showed 28 of 40 pages 'changed' — checked and it is NOT a regression: `framework/styles/layers/theme/lew42/lew42.css`, a shared theme file, was edited by another concurrent agent mid-test (its mtime falls inside the test window) — the tool correctly caught a real, live site-wide change in flight, which is exactly its job.

- `public/framework/ext/DesignTool/diff/site-diff.mjs` — `shoot()` (page-pool + `inFlight` assertion), `serialGoto()`, `diffAll()`/summary (`unknown` handling)
- [Site diff](/framework/ext/DesignTool/diff/) — unchanged page, still linked from DesignTool's front
